novelty_flags.label: thm:crossing-geometry
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed causal crossing diagnostic is already stated in BonviniKennedyKeele2023MinimaxSubgroup, rather than being a new transfer from classification.

soundness_flags.label: ass:density-bounds
soundness_flags.one_line: This is labelled Audibert--Tsybakov's strong density assumption but omits its required regular-support condition; either add regularity of the support or rename it as bounded density on the fixed support.

soundness_flags.label: def:holder-ball and ass:near-band-holder/off-band-holder/propensity-holder/control-holder
soundness_flags.one_line: The declared Holder ball controls only a highest-derivative increment and is not the standard Taylor-remainder Holder class used by the cited papers, especially at integer orders.

soundness_flags.label: thm:causal-well-posedness
soundness_flags.one_line: The equality to E[Y^1-Y^0|X=x] is asserted pointwise although the assumptions designate only a continuous observed-regression version; state equality P_X-a.e. or explicitly designate the causal conditional-mean version.

soundness_flags.label: def:transverse-witness, thm:transverse-witness, and thm:transverse-minimax-rate
soundness_flags.one_line: The witness resets global X and theta and does not constrain M_Y, density constants, margin constants, or t_0, so it need not belong to the fixed model and cannot establish nonemptiness for the stated minimax theorem.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:full-supermargin-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Nonemptiness of M is asked as a function only of (d,xi,gamma), although it also depends on fixed support, threshold, radii, density constants, margin constants, and the remaining smoothness parameters.

soundness_flags.label: thm:transverse-minimax-rate
soundness_flags.one_line: Its claimed Bonvini--Kennedy--Keele reduction is impossible under its own hypotheses: xi=1 and gamma>d imply xi gamma>d, contradicting the comparator restriction xi gamma<=d.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, paragraph following Proposition 2; p. 10, Corollary 1 and Theorem 1; p. 16, Conclusions
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states that xi min(1,gamma)<=1 is necessary for an interior CATE crossing under a density bounded above and below; Corollary 1 gives r_n^{*1+xi}, while Theorem 1 assumes xi gamma<=d and the conclusion calls removal of that assumption open.
The published strong-density assumption requires support on a compact (c0,r0)-regular set in addition to density bounds; Proposition 3.4 gives the interior-crossing obstruction alpha min(1,beta)<=1.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Theorem 1--Theorem 2 and regularity conditions in Sections 3--4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes the two-branch pointwise-CATE minimax rate using localized fuzzy hypotheses and a higher-order local-polynomial R-learner, under explicit regularity and estimator-side conditions.
The paper studies plug-in density-level-set rates under local smoothness and a margin-type exponent, with Holder-class minimax lower bounds.
The article exists as Towards optimal doubly robust estimation of heterogeneous causal effects and studies a local-polynomial doubly robust CATE estimator.
